To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the MWCNTs embedded Au particles exhibit a higher activity for EOR in alkaline medium than the Au substrate, and this is attributed to the synergistic effects of the MWCNT-Au composite.

the MWCNTs inserted in the Au composite microparticles exhibit a better performance for the EOR than the pure Au substrate, and the enhanced EOR performance of the MWCNT-Au composite microparticles is mainly attributed to the MWCNT insertions.
the electrochemical performance of MWCNTs/Au composite microparticles for ethanol oxidation reaction (EO) was investigated by cyclic voltammetry and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation and electrocatalytic properties of a novel electrocatalyst of MWCNTs inserted with Au particles for the EOR.
the synthesis and electrochemical properties of the MWCNTs embedded Au microparticles.
the electrocatalytic performance of MWCNTs inserted into the Au composite particles toward EOR.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the MWCNTs in the composite microparticles are beneficial to improve the electrocatalytic performance toward EOR.
the MWCNTs inserted in the Au particles are beneficial for the EOR and the MWCNT-Au composite microparticles are promising electrocatalysts for EOR.
the MWCNTs in the MWCNT-Au composites can effectively enhance the electrocatalytic activity of Au toward EOR.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

MWCNTs in the MWCNTs/Au composite microparticles can effectively improve the EOR performance of Au particles, and the EOR performance on the MWCNT-Au composite microparticle is superior to the pure Au substrate and the MWCNT/Au composite film.
the electrocatalytic EOR performance of Au particles can be significantly enhanced by the MWCNTs insertion into the Au particles.
the MWCNTs can be inserted into the gold particles and act as an electrocatalytic support, thus enhancing the EOR activity of the MWCNT-Au composite.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the MWCNTs in the composite microparticles play a key role to enhance the electrocatalytic activity for the EOR, and the Au particles in the MWCNT-Au composites act as the active site for the EOR.
the MWCNTs inserted in the Au composite particles are beneficial to enhance the electrocatalytic activity for EOR.
the MWCNTs in the MWCNT-Au composite microparticles can act as an electrochemical catalyst for the EOR and also as a support for the Au catalyst.
